problems: One dossier only (the group's owned list has one state); it validates with 0 errors and 2 warnings (vassal_start for cimmerian-bosporus and kingdom-of-armenia have no vassal_end: the relations run to 395).

Used the full 14-page budget: List of Roman provinces (empty tables) and Augustus gave almost nothing dated; the productive page was Roman client kingdoms. Roman-Germanic_wars did not load under either spelling; Germanic_Wars did.

Dates and cell counts of Cliopatria shape changes were obtained by differencing the shapes with the gazetteer library (not a page); every page-backed claim cites one of the 14 pages, the rest is marked confidence 1 or 'unverified: page budget'.

Boundary decisions to wire: the dossier starts 16 January 27 BC (the Republic dossier ends then) and ends 17 January 395 with split events to western-roman-empire and eastern-roman-empire; year 395 is shared with the successors, and roman-empire_395 is a new keyframe.

The Republic dossier opens vassal tints (Thrace, Judaea, Mauretania) that it never closes; this dossier re-opens the clients that continue (Thrace, Judaea, Cappadocia, Commagene, Nabataea, Bosporus, Galatia, Pontus) on 16 January 27 BC and closes them at annexation.

Disagreement with Cliopatria for the eu-04-b dossiers: Crisis of the Third Century page dates the Palmyrene Empire to 267 (Egypt late 271) and the Gallic Empire to 260, Cliopatria has both from 261; Gaul is reunited by late 274 but Cliopatria keeps the Gallic row to 282.

Counterparts given as plain strings (no dossier yet): Britannic Empire (Carausius and Allectus), Magnus Maximus (usurper), Eugenius (usurper), Dacians (Dacian kingdom), Alemanni, Kingdom of Noricum, Cilicia Trachea (client kingdom); the wiring to slugs awaits eu-04-x.
